## How it was tested

- [ ] `cargo test --workspace`
- [ ] New/changed middleware has unit tests and an engine-level test
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace --features cli-e2e` (if `moonlit run` behaviour changed)

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] README of the plugin updated for new/changed inputs or outputs
- [ ] Breaking change marked with `!` in the title and explained above
